title: Capability
description: A named, versioned skill an agent claims to be able to perform (e.g. 'terraform.generate'). Capabilities are the unit against which evidence is produced and reputation is accrued.

version.description: Version of the capability contract (semantic versioning recommended).

description.description: Human-readable description of what the capability does.

input_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing valid task inputs for this capability.

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing valid task outputs for this capability. Evidence.schema_valid refers to validation against this schema.

extensions.description: Open bag for vendor or profile extensions. Keys SHOULD be namespaced (e.g. 'vendor.example/field').
